    F(0) = 1 (empty set)
    F(1) = 2 ({}, {1})
    F(N) = F(N-1) + F(N-2)
    """

    if N == 0:
        return 1
    if N == 1:

    f_minus_1 = 2  # F(1)

        f_minus_2 = f_minus_1
        f_minus_1 = current_f
